reason: Build job failed with HookWebpackError: _webpack.WebpackError is not a constructor from minify-webpack-plugin. Fixed by removing @napi-rs/canvas from webpackConfig.externals (which conflicted with minify-webpack-plugin) and replacing it with NormalModuleReplacementPlugin (from Next.js's bundled webpack) to intercept node: protocol imports, redirecting them to the empty stub. The key insight was that webpack config callbacks run in Node.js at build time where require is available, allowing access to webpack's bundled modules via require('next/dist/compiled/webpack/webpack.js').
